description: Per-dataset validation models (LR, RF, XGBoost) with protein-aware splits
split_strategy: Protein-aware: no protein shared between train/val/test

htr_selex_prjeb25907.note: EDA complete. Scripts 02+03 not yet run for this dataset. Re-run: python scripts/02b_train_htr_selex_validation.py

test.flagged_explanation: RBM4/RBM4B are closely related paralogs with near-identical binding profiles; XRCC6 is an atypical RBP — these are hard biological cases, not data quality issues

test.note: XGB (0.628) slightly outperforms LR (0.590) on unseen test proteins. Only 4 test proteins — high variance.
test.flagged_explanation: Small test set (only 4 proteins, 23 total). Limited generalization expected with k-mer features.

key_observations: Val AUROC (unseen proteins) consistently 0.75-0.82 — confirms datasets are learnable with k-mer features
Test AUROC drops to 0.63 on held-out proteins — k-mer bag-of-words fails to generalize across very different proteins
RBNS has RNA length 20nt vs HTR-SELEX 40nt — cross-dataset k-mer features are not directly comparable (scale mismatch)
3 hard proteins in RBNS (RBM4, RBM4B, XRCC6) consistently below threshold — biological hard cases
Phase 2 V2 CNN uses raw sequences + global max pooling — length-agnostic and expected to generalize better

v1_mlp_kmer.failure_mode: Best AUROC at epoch 1 then degrades — k-mer cross-dataset length mismatch causes incompatible feature distributions
v1_mlp_kmer.conclusion: k-mer MLP not viable for cross-dataset generalization
